items.title: Globus Medical confirms it has bought Synaptive Medical out of receivership, moving into cranial neurosurgery
items.summary: Globus Medical announced on 03/11/2026 that it acquired Synaptive Medical, a Toronto-area maker of surgical visualisation, navigation, planning and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) technology.

items.title: RCNi Nursing Leadership Summit: Migraine and Headache, London, 30 October 2026
items.summary: In-person day at RCN HQ London for nurses in migraine, headache and neurology care, with expert-led learning and nurse-led service development examples. Organised by RCNi, sponsored by Teva UK, with a promotional stand. Expression of interest required and places are not guaranteed.

items.title: Regeneron’s cemdisiran approved by FDA in generalised myasthenia gravis
items.summary: The FDA approved Regeneron’s Alnylam-licensed siRNA cemdisiran, the second targeted gMG therapy cleared that week, taking Regeneron into neurology.

items.title: Boston Scientific prices $3.0bn and €4.25bn senior notes to fund its pending $14.5bn Penumbra acquisition
items.summary: Boston Scientific announced on 19/11/2026 the pricing of $3.0bn of US dollar senior notes and, through American Medical Systems Europe B.V., €4.25bn of euro notes, expected to close on 1 December 2026, to finance the cash consideration for its acquisition of Penumbra, Inc.

items.title: Medtronic to acquire Contego Medical (Neuroguard carotid systems, Excipio thrombectomy) for $380m
items.summary: Medtronic announced on 16/11/2026 that it will acquire Contego Medical, a privately held company, valued at $380m with potential payments post-acquisition.
